normalization: Total-count normalize to 10000 then natural log1p; use original full library total
PGAM5: Exclude only from geometry; retain all raw counts and all zeros in expression comparison
interpretation: Exploratory RNA marker annotation; no CNV/doublet/ambient correction; no protein/causal claims
inference: Descriptive group expression comparison. Marker Wilcoxon is for annotation, not patient-level confirmation.
